basic_info.description: Light filled spacious 1 bedroom with amazing bay and GG views, formal dining room, walk in closet Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 120% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person = $125,900; 2 = $143,900; 3 = $161,800; 4 = $179,800; 5 = $194,200, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, 9-18-2024. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on 10-10-2024 at 5:00 PM. Fair Housing Opportunity.
